description: No-defer TWIN of `server-callee-error-total-handler`: the same release call, written as the last statement before `return` instead of deferred. With the same transport error the observable result must be identical: @out = "OK", trace = "work;release-failed;".
rationale: §19.16.2: a deferred body runs at the block's exit; with a total handler and no control transfer, deferring the final release is observably identical to writing it before the return.
